title: Lyrion Music Server
descript: Lyrion Music Server (formerly Logitech Media Server) streams your music library to Squeezebox players and phones, with plugins for streaming services and multi-room synchronisation. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container with a wrapper that starts the perl server directly.
important: Open the web UI on port 8106, point the music folder at /music and install the plugins you need. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/lyriondocker/ and survives restarts and updates. Put your music in the music folder (or add extra volumes). The container runs as uid 1000. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
